## Ravenfield VR 1.16.14

- The M1 GARRET's operating rod stays back with the bolt when it locks open on the emptied clip (it went forward alone), and is taken there.
- The M1's bolt going home no longer plays its whole reload sound (clip push and all) on every rack.
- Taking a soldier by the neck or the body no longer grabs a second soldier's gun beside him instead.
- Pulling a slide or bolt back plays only its pull, and letting it go home only the slide going home: on many guns the pull played the whole rack, back and home.
- Scoped guns whose flat scope picture is a reticle image (some mod guns) show that reticle in the VR scope lens instead of the mod's plain crosshair.
- A magazine or gun let go with the hand pushed deep into the ground no longer falls through the world beside a bank of terrain or a building's foundation: it comes up onto the ground.
- A punch that lands no longer takes the soldier's gun on the same squeeze.
- Taken over into another soldier by a map or a mod, the hands let go of what they held, as after a death; a grip held through the death screen no longer grabs the steering wheel of the next life's first vehicle.
